details:
- Upgrade to openjdk-shenandoah-jdk8u-shenandoah-jdk8u514-b01 (OpenJDK
  jdk8u514-ga merged onto shenandoah8u512-b04, as upstream has not yet
  tagged a Shenandoah 8u514 release). That fixes following CVEs:
- CVE-2026-114939: JGSS, remote high-complexity confidentiality and
  integrity flaw in Kerberos ticket handling
- CVE-2026-114940: JSSE, remote high-complexity confidentiality and
  integrity flaw in TLS client connections
- CVE-2026-114943: Hotspot runtime, remote high-complexity DoS and
  partial integrity flaw
- CVE-2026-114944: Serviceability, remote high-complexity integrity flaw
  in JMX connections
- CVE-2026-114946: Hotspot compiler, remote high-complexity partial
  confidentiality and integrity flaw in loop handling
- The upgrade also delivers the security fixes of OpenJDK 8u504 and
  8u512 (OpenJDK vulnerability advisories 2026/08/18, 2026/10/20,
  2026/10/21 and 2026/10/24), which this branch had not shipped yet:
- Fixed in OpenJDK 8u504:
  - CVE-2026-60589: security-libs/javax.xml.crypto
  - CVE-2026-61308: core-libs/java.net
  - CVE-2026-70907: security-libs/javax.net.ssl
